mission: Build a brand-learning-capability-test that proves evidence-backed visual rules can generate distinct demo structures without mirroring a website, applying to a host, or disguising a branded asset template as learning.
allowedInputs: source screenshots as read-only composition evidence
forbiddenInputs: previous QA verdict before initial implementation
tasks: map each reference page to a distinct demo page
rebuild composition with source DOM/CSS and independently inventoried original site assets
complete each section micro-gate before full-page QA
prove every actionable control changes and can restore observable state
inventory every high-salience visual pattern and runtime asset provenance before QA
create a generative variation that reuses learned invariants with different content or structure
record implemented, missing and pre-authorized transformations
requirements: brand color, official asset status and logo do not substitute for composition

source screenshots and crops are QA evidence only and never Demo runtime assets unless the sealed goal explicitly has goalType screenshot-recreation and implementationPolicy.allowSourceScreenshotAsRuntimeAsset true
every high-salience runtime asset records provenance sourceUrl, sourceSha256, role and sourceKind
allowed sourceKind values are original-site-asset, dom-css-reconstruction and generated-independent-asset
every high-salience visual pattern has an approved pattern id plus evidenceRefs and sourceRegion

every pattern claiming a composition mustPreserve id declares preserves and compositionSupport with source/demo asset identity plus variant, at least two bounded structural layers, and any aspect/crop translation
a color role may only be used in its declared allowedRoles
all transformations exist in goal-contract.mayTranslate before implementation
generative-proof.json identifies invariant learned rules, the deliberately varied input or structure, and why the result remains in-system without copying a full source composition
fresh independent Visual QA being pending is the expected next stage, not a Demo failure or needs-evidence verdict, when all implementation-owned gates pass
mustNot: invent a translation justification after implementation
use an unproven placeholder as official
copy a source screenshot, screenshot crop, or reference-derived full-frame raster into the Demo runtime
claim screenshot-derived pixels as DOM/CSS reconstruction or original source assets
passCriteria: implementation-side evidence, structure and generative artifacts are complete enough to dispatch fresh Visual QA; only Visual QA/finalize may mark the three proofs passed
failCriteria: color role expanded into an unapproved component role
generative proof is missing, circular, or only demonstrates a website mirror or asset swap
receiptRequirements: agentExecutionId from a real spawned subagent
input and output file sha256 values
on fail, failureOwnerRole identifies brandResearcher, designTranslator, designDirectorOrchestrator, or demoImplementationAgent
